correctness.rationale: Reconstructed precise one-shot iid-mark model and terminal event. Backward ancestor paths give almost-sure well-defined infinite dynamics. Solved one-sided a'(u)=p(1-b), b'(u)=q(1-a) with zero initial data. E={X0=X1} equals independent E_L intersect E_R, each defined on disjoint input marks and implying correct full-line halfline evolution. This proves full conditional independence and w_A,w_B by integrating one-sided occupations. The positive power-series coefficients of 2(cosh gamma +2-3sinh gamma/gamma) for all degree >=4 imply 0<K<1/5, with sharp small-gamma limit. A-X-A existing exact formula yields nonzero conditional one-vacancy covariance. New checker.py exhaustively enumerated five finite path/bias cases, including whole-halfline conditional rank one, with 180 assertions passed. Numerical checks are diagnostic and not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: A double-vacancy is a natural jammed-substrate defect separating two adsorption domains. Full conditional independence of entire exterior configurations is a structural result stronger than small-cylinder arithmetic; it is sharp because a single vacancy has nonzero conditional A-flank covariance. Sharp universal fivefold contraction of species bias quantifies strong minority enrichment in domain boundaries, with a nontrivial (3/5,2/5) limiting law even as one proposal color dominates. These predictions are not obtained from known one-point or monochromatic-run marginal counts, and inform spatial domain observables.
